terms.definition: A customer's confirmed purchase: the aggregate that owns line items, totals, and the order lifecycle once checkout succeeds. It is created by PlaceOrder and is the root the rest of fulfilment hangs off.
The per-variant product identifier stock is tracked against. Reservation and availability checks key off the SKU, not the product.
A soft hold placed on inventory for a SKU while an order is being placed, released if payment fails.
Referenced in code comments as an alternate path when stock is unavailable, but no reachable handler was found.
terms.openQuestion: Is backorder a real supported flow or dead intent? No code path reserves against future stock; a human who knows the business should confirm whether backorder is expected to work.
